maya: Morning — quick triage sprint snapshot.

maya: Tickets: 38 open (5 P1s, 11 P2s). Top buckets: webhook failures (12), billing (8), embeddings drift (6).

jonah: Thanks. Any new spikes on webhooks? :eyes:

maya: Yeah, webhook failures are mostly `HTTP 502/504` from partner endpoint B. We've got 3 customer-facing escalations.

triage-bot: Alert: partner-B-backend errors increased 4x in the last 30m. See incident card: https://redwood.in/incidents/987

samir: I'm on webhook escalations. Root cause looks like a new proxy config. Working on a temp retry macro.

olivia: For macros — can we add a short modal response for transient upstream errors? 'We've received this, retrying — no action needed.' 

maya: Proposed macro (w/ small snippet):

```
Name: upstream-transient-ack
Trigger: webhook 5xx OR connection-failure
Message: "Thanks — we saw a transient error from the partner. We're retrying and will follow up if it persists."
Tags: customer_ack, autosent
```

samir: LGTM. I'll raise PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/support-macros/pull/42

jonah: Can you also add a one-liner to the macro that suggests the customer check their endpoint timeout? helps reduce cycles.

samir: will add. pinging @olivia for review once PR is up.

olivia: I can review after standup, ETA 11:30 PT. Also, I updated the billing template yesterday — small wording tweak for refund steps.

maya: Nice. Blockers: need someone to own the P1 on embeddings drift — looks like a model rollout artifact. @jonah? :pray:

jonah: I can take a look after I finish the webhook rollback. Might be a 2hr deep-dive.

triage-bot: Reminder: shift handoff in 1h — please mark tickets with 'on-deck' before leaving.

maya: Thanks — quick asks: (1) samir please cut the PR for the macro, (2) jonah take embeddings P1, (3) everyone update hotlist.

olivia: done for (3).

samir: PR opened, tagged triage and ops: https://github.com/redwood-inference/support-macros/pull/42 :thumbsup:
